body:
I don't remember which API we have decided on in the last RFC meeting, but what if

```js
stack.add(container => menu({ container, attribute: 'categories' }));
```

in `add()` we can create a container and set the object to `localWidgets` altogether.
how would you know what the attribute is in that case?

I've tried a similar option in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4659/commits/b785c1cb740ca421c36fd904144b84819ccde99c#diff-e1fb3ad37886947412250842890ce946afafddf6239f99be67cd710141bf6275
Nice little addition for a good impact :)
